Low: 2750 Cot3Strapu $65; 2750 Cotu Classic $75; 2750 OG Canvas $90; high: 1925 Canvas and 2390 Made In Italy $300.

notes: Refund policy: returns within 30 days of delivery, unworn with tags; a company return label costs $6.95, deducted from the refund. Cart: You are $100.00 USD away from free shipping (threshold $100). Expedited $19.99.
About: founded 1911 by Walter Martiny in Turin, named after the nearby Basilica of Superga. Product copy: the 2750 is The People's Shoe of Italy; a Made in Italy line exists.
